newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Flughafen sees net profit down 10 pct.
newsitem.headline: Flughafen sees net profit down 10 pct.

text.p: Vienna Airport operator Flughafen Wien said on Monday it expected a 10 percent drop in 1996 net profit to around 600 million schillings, compared to 673.3 million last year.
The management recommended increasing the dividend, but would not give any details. The dividend in 1995 was 12 percent.
Flughafen said it expected income from the aviation and non-aviation divisions to rise by four percent, but this operating costs were seen rising eight percent.
Higher costs were due to higher depreciation resulting from intensive construction, high material expenditure in winter months and the costs of future projects, the company noted.

Flughafen said the current goal of achieving average annual growth of eight percent between 1988 and 2000 would be extended to 2002 and raised to 8.5 percent, necessitating further expansion of airport facilities from 1999.
The airport would finance investments and projects from its own capital, it continued.
Margins on earnings before interest and tax for 1996 would be around 18 percent and would increase to 25 percent by the year 2000.

The company said a crucial success factor was the return on capital employed which would be raised to 15 percent in the year 2000 from the current 12.5 percent before taxes for 1996. -- Vienna newsroom, +431 531 12257
